column1: # READ EVERY LINE OF THIS FILE BEFORE USING IT
# This is a template you can use to quickly upload accounts into the app data.
# Open this file in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
# Save it again as a CSV when you are finished adding rows.
# Do not include commas in any field including notes! The import will fail if you have commas.
# Review the add account selections in the app to understand the options for account types and properties. Match text exactly when adding an account.
# KEEP EVERY COLUMN. The import needs the full header row exactly as written below.
#   Delete a column and nothing imports. Leave a CELL blank to take its default.
#   Always start from this template or from an export made by this version of the app.
# The import is all-or-nothing. If any row cannot be read the whole file is rejected
#   and nothing is added

column1: # ID is optional. Provide a valid UUID from export to preserve existing IDs. Leave blank to generate one.
# IsClosed is optional. Leave blank to default to FALSE (open account).
# ContributionGrowthRate is optional. It sets how the monthly contribution changes each year.
#   It is a SIGNED adjustment against your inflation setting - not a flat rate on its own.
#   Use 0 to have contributions track inflation. Use -0.01 to fall 1% behind it each year.
#   With the inflation setting turned off in the app it acts as a plain annual increase.
#   Leave blank for 0.
# Percentage for ReturnRate LoanRate or ContributionGrowthRate should be entered as 0.00 - ex. 2.00% enter 0.02
#   ContributionGrowthRate accepts a NEGATIVE value. Valid range is -0.05 to 0.10.
# CurrentBalance should have NO commas or symbols. Enter as 12345.67.
# BalanceDate is optional. Use yyyy-MM-dd format (e.g. 2025-01-15). Leave blank to use today's date.
# AccountCurrency is optional. Use 3-letter ISO code: USD EUR GBP etc. Leave blank to use your default currency.
# LogoDomain is optional. DO NOT manually enter values - only copy from exported data. The app will reconstruct the account logo.
# Owners is recommended to leave blank. Matching existing names (or 'Joint') will assign directly. Failed matches will require a manual review.
# All imports without an owner assigned will be listed under 'Pending Imports' for your review.
